rules.entry: first market open more than 5 minutes after the signal, on the stock's own exchange (crypto: next 00:00 UTC)
rules.exit: close on the last trading day on or before entry date + 7 / 30 / 91 days
rules.return: price change plus splits and cash dividends (not reinvested), in the stock's own currency
rules.counting: every signal counts, including a stock picked again in later runs
